# ex: matching with interface types
ex {
	var x error
	F(x) -> G(x)
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F(x error) string { return x.Error() }
func G(x error) string { return "err: " + x.Error() }

func H(e error) string { return F(e) }
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -3,4 +3,4 @@
 func F(x error) string { return x.Error() }
 func G(x error) string { return "err: " + x.Error() }

-func H(e error) string { return F(e) }
+func H(e error) string { return G(e) }
